description:
Finish what octo-3di.9 stubbed. Replace
`OctoPi.TUI.Interactive.run/1`'s "not implemented" message with
the real message pump:

1. Start Session (agent) with model/tools from opts.
2. Start Terminal (accept `:name` opt so tests can avoid the
   named-process conflict; production uses the default name).
3. Start StdinFSM subscribed to self().
4. Start Renderer with current dimensions + csi_2026 support.
5. Subscribe to `:stdin_chunk` and `:resize` on Events, and to
   agent events via `OctoPi.Agent.subscribe/3`.
6. Initial render.
7. Main loop (receive):
   - `{:stdin_chunk, bin}` → StdinFSM.process
   - `{:stdin_event, seq}` → KeyParser.parse → handle_event →
     re-render if state changed → exit if `state.exit`
   - `{:resize, w, h}` → Renderer.resize + handle_event + re-render
   - `{:octo_pi_agent_event, _}` → handle_event + re-render
8. On exit: stop Renderer, StdinFSM, Terminal (which triggers
   RawMode.exit via terminate/2) — return :ok.

Other touches:
- Terminal.write/2 helper that emits bytes via the configured
  write_fn (default IO.write, override-able for tests).
- Interactive.run/1 accepts `:write_fn` so tests capture output.

TDD:
- E2E: start Interactive with FakeTransport, write_fn captures
  bytes. Feed "hi\\r" + wait for agent response + feed Ctrl+C.
  Assert the captured output contains "hi" and the assistant
  text; assert run/1 returned :ok.
- Resize handling: feed a simulated resize event, assert
  Renderer.resize was called + the state width/height updated.
- Ctrl+C during agent work: abort + clean exit.
title: Interactive main loop: wire Terminal+FSM+Renderer end-to-end
